gbm_population_evidence.quote: Must have WHO Grade IV Glioblastoma or gliosarcoma based on histopathological OR molecular criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: Monoclonal antibodies, such as MBG453 and spartalizumab may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Trial of Anti-Tim-3 in Combination With Anti-PD-1 and SRS in Recurrent GBM

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the pharmacodynamic activity in tumor tissue and peripheral blood in treated subjects who undergo tumor biopsies as clinically indicated.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive MBG453 and spartalizumab IV over 30 minutes on Day 1.
